description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). DG(no index, 2 rows, keys 1, 2; t 'a1', 'a2') and DH(no index, 6 rows, keys 1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 3; u 'b1' to 'b6'); DI(k primary key, keys 1, 2) with the same payloads as DG. SELECT t, u FROM DG INNER JOIN DH; DG LEFT JOIN DH; DH LEFT JOIN DG; DI LEFT JOIN DH; FROM DG, DH WHERE DG.k = DH.k. Asks whether the unindexed side's matches of one key come in reverse storage order for three duplicates (b4, b3, b1?), also against an indexed preserved side and for a WHERE join.
